dict.title: إعداد الوكيل المسبق
dict.description: Applies to sessions you start from now on. قيد التشغيل sessions keep the preset they began with.
dict.seatHint: ‏Agent preset for the session you are about to start
dict.headerHint: ‏The agent preset this session runs, fixed when it started
dict.sectionIntro: ‏A preset is the plugin composition one session's agent runs — its tools, prompt, and capabilities. Duplicate an existing one and make it yours, or let the agent draft one for you in Creator mode.
dict.presetStandardDescription: ‏Full coding agent with file editing, shell, file and web search, skills, planning, goals, subagents, and workflows.
dict.presetCodeDescription: ‏All Standard mode capabilities, with tools exposed through the Code Mode SDK so the model can combine multi-step operations in one TypeScript program.
dict.presetMinimalDescription: ‏Two-tool coding agent with persistent bash and str_replace_editor.
dict.presetCordisDescription: ‏Built for creating custom agent presets, with all Standard mode capabilities plus runtime inspection, plugin experiments, and preset-authoring guidance.
dict.duplicateUnavailable: ‏This deployment has no writable preset directory
dict.displayNamePlaceholder: ‏Shown in the picker; defaults to the identifier
dict.brokenNoCopy: ‏A preset that failed to load cannot be duplicated
dict.copyIntro: ‏The whole preset is copied on this machine. The identifier becomes its directory name and cannot be changed later; everything else is edited in the preset's own files.
dict.creatorDraft: ‏Draft a custom preset with Creator mode
dict.idInvalid: ‏Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
dict.idTaken: ‏A preset with this identifier already exists.
dict.deleteDescription: ‏The preset directory is deleted. Sessions already running on it keep working; new sessions cannot select it.
